name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ui_menu status screen). No address residue. Accurately describes the function: a loop that lets the player pick a party member from the roster and view that member's status screen, looping until Esc. 'run...menu' matches the modal-loop shape used by the sibling menu functions in this file.
purpose: Chapter-intro status-screen viewer loop: repeatedly let the player pick a party member from the roster and view that member's status screen, reloading the DATO.DAT portrait sheet between picks, until Esc.
logic_summary: Sets ui_menu_visible_item_count = shared_menu_party_member_count (present the full roster). Then loops: call fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop() (sel); fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out(); save dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset; if sel == -1 break (Esc). Otherwise fd2_open_char_status_screen(ui_menu_cursor_idx); restore dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset; reload the portrait resource via fd2_load_dat_resource("DATO.DAT" path 0x51A70, current portrait_sprite_buffer, chapter_intro_menu_speaker_portrait_id_table[0]) storing the returned pointer back into portrait_sprite_buffer (the status screen overwrote the portrait sheet). Repeat. In the binary EBX and ESI both hold sel (EBX gates the in-body break, ESI the loop-back test), both vs -1, so it is an infinite loop with an Esc break; EDI saves the portrait blit offset across the submenu (restored only on the non-Esc path). __CHK(0x1c) is the compiler-injected stack-probe prologue.

returns.semantics: No return value; returns when the roster select yields -1 (Esc).
